name: The Hunter
description: A practical woodsman whose offhand logic about beauty and ugliness drives the tale’s twist.
visualPrompt: A rugged hunter in simple old-fashioned forest clothing with a satchel and boots, calm expression and weathered face, standing in a woodland setting with earthy tones and a straightforward, no-nonsense demeanor

name: The Snipe
description: A small bird and proud mother who insists her chicks are the prettiest in the forest, only to be proven humorously biased.
visualPrompt: A small adult snipe with mottled brown and tan plumage, slender beak, alert eyes, wings slightly lifted in protest, posed on mossy ground in a sun-dappled forest, conveying anxious maternal pride

name: The Young Snipes
description: The snipe’s chicks, ordinary-looking and vulnerable, at the center of the misunderstanding about what “prettiest” means.
visualPrompt: A cluster of tiny young snipes with downy mottled feathers and small beaks, huddled close together, looking fragile and ordinary, set against leaves and twigs on the forest floor in a gentle storybook style
